item.title: zosma-qa — via awesome-appium
item.description: Unified QA platform with one CLI for Appium mobile testing, Playwright web E2E, and k6 load tests — includes zero-config scaffolding, WebdriverIO test helpers, and AI agents that autonomously plan, generate, and self-heal your test suites.

item.title: TestMu AI — via awesome-appium
item.description: AI-native cloud testing platform (formerly LambdaTest), run Appium tests in parallel on real Android and iOS devices.

item.title: FrontRow — via awesome-appium
item.description: Open source React Native concert ticketing app built specifically as a QA automation training surface. Ships Appium WebdriverIO and TypeScript scaffolds with full WDIO configs for iOS and Android, smoke and login specs, and a central testID registry that maps to accessibility identifiers on both platforms. Includes a QA Debug Menu with force error modes, time travel, and deterministic IAP outcomes for practising failure mode testing.
